info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v4-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the list of partners associated with hotel loyalty points programs. Consumers can utilize this endpoint to retrieve vital information about various partners that enhance customer loyalty experiences. Typical use cases include integrating partner data into loyalty platforms, assisting hotel franchises in collaboration efforts, and enabling marketing campaigns. The API ensures that developers can efficiently retrieve and utilize the partner information to drive customer engagement and satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of partner points.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of partner points available in the system. It can be used to gather information about various points associated with partners for reporting and analytical purposes.
